verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a single-email send endpoint and merge-field personalization. Nothing in the pack shows a batch or bulk send that accepts multiple personalized messages in one request and returns per-message status. The bulk capability that is cited (email verification) belongs to a different story and does not transfer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient
